channel.title: Version 9.2 :: Hugo Relearn Theme
channel.description: 9.2.0 (2026-10-10) Enhancements [feature] menu: support continuation for hugo menus #1309 [feature] taxonomy: make output formats work #1308 [feature] search: make dedicated search page printable #1307 [feature] mermaid: make graphs linkable similar to images #1302 [feature][change] theme: add deprecation warnings #1297 [feature] generator: fix multiple issues #1296 [feature] mermaid: enlarge width to content #1294 [feature] mermaid: improve zoomable graphs #1292 [feature] openapi: support lang parameter #1291 [feature] menu: improve controls #1289 [feature] theme: animate expander #1288 [feature] theme: rounded corners #1285 [feature] a11y: add contrast variant #1283 [feature] a11y: officially support accessibility #1282 [feature][change] topbar: make it configurable similar to sidebar #1281 [feature][change] versioning: use Hugo’s matrix feature #1280 [feature] blockquote: support attribution attributes #1278 [feature] resources: add pageref parameter #1276 [feature][change] children: rewrite as pages shortcode #1273 [feature][change] math: switch from MathJax to Katex #1271 [feature][change] table: support merging cells #1267 [feature] theme: add SBOM #1265 [feature] theme: avoid Javascript in HTML pages to support CSP #1264 [feature] a11y: improve content flow and landmarks #1258 [feature][change] taxonomy: support additional custom grouping #1194 [feature] breadcrumbs: show full text on hover if overflow hides it #1191 [feature] mermaid: open diagram on full screen #1131 Fixes [bug] variant: improve legacy variants #1306 [bug][change] search: don’t bury exact hits under similar words #1300 [bug] variant: fix some neon issues #1298 [bug] theme: don’t mix up localstorage for different projects #1295 [bug] boxstyle: keep title if no i18n text was found #1293 [bug] code: fix tab focus #1290 [bug] print: improve #1287 [bug] tags: fix visual gap #1284 [bug] theme: fix heading scrolling when select element has focus #1268 Maintenance [task] logo: rename direction to layout #1310 [task] menu: make elements multiinstanceable #1304 [task] build: get rid of deprecation warnings in GitHub Actions #1301 [task] openapi: switch to shadow DOM #1299 [task][change] expand: retire in favor to details #1279 [task] openapi: update swagger-ui to 5.33.0 #1275 [task][change] notice: rename to callout #1272 [task] theme: modernize some JavaScript #1269
